news.title: Tong Herr to table RM100 mil privatisation plan to shareholders

recent_en: Tong Herr is proceeding with its privatisation via a Selective Capital Reduction and Repayment (SCR) exercise, with shareholders passing the special resolution at the EGM on 3 November 2026. The company issued a circular to shareholders on 12 October 2026 and announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 27 November.
notable_en: Shareholders passed the special resolution for the privatisation at the EGM held on 3 November 2026.
The company issued a circular to shareholders on 12 October 2026 regarding the privatisation.
risks_en: The privatisation is via a Selective Capital Reduction and Repayment (SCR) exercise, involving capital reduction and capital repayment to shareholders.
